decisions.reason: Because a vegan superfood drink mix is distant from the firm's core waste-to-energy and biomass conversion knowledge, limiting absorptive capacity and making it hard to learn from weak market signals.
As a modular waste-to-energy extension, it closely matches the firm's existing technical and market knowledge, enabling effective assimilation and improvement.
The waste oil to energy plant is squarely within the firm's core waste-to-energy expertise and shows strong market evidence, so absorptive capacity supports continued learning and retention.
The plastic waste to fuel plant is close to the firm's established waste conversion capabilities, allowing the firm to exploit related knowledge and improve the product.
